name: March Madness

date.source: The fed's own broadcast, live from the Alamodome, San Antonio, Texas.

matches.note: Tag Team Championship. Lasher and Mystikal retain, Lasher finishing Overpower with a clothesline after a top-rope rocket launch on Millenium.

Main event: the Best of the Best battle royal among the fed's five reigning singles champions and one further entrant. Lasher and Chaos are double-disqualified after a brawl spills to ringside; Tony Morris eliminates Skye Daniels last to win, then the two shake hands.

notes: The fed's own sole surviving pay-per-view, read and served across all four of its parts. Two further matches (Handsome David Parker vs. "The E.Y.Con" Nick Machiavelli, opening the card; Devil vs. Joshua "The Unseen" Curry in a steel cage, won by Curry) and the Intercontinental Championship match (Hustler defeating Eldar "The Crusher" Markovich for the vacant title) are not structured, their combatants unminted, and survive in the served pages' own verbatim text. A grudge match between Cannibus and Sinister Shakur ends without a fall between the two, dissolving into the pair assaulting a third wrestler, Devil, in a lynching angle continuing a storyline the broadcast says began when a wrestler named Malik Mustafa lynched another named Jonathan O'Malley; neither man is minted. The broadcast opens with a card change: Chaos and Death Master both win newly created or vacant titles by forfeit after their scheduled opponents' retirements.
